description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait' providing properties and getter/setter methods for 'fromDate' and 'toDate' as DateTime objects or null, used for filtering date ranges in leave-related data transfer objects.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the 'fromDate' property, a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the 'fromDate' property with a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the 'toDate' property, a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the 'toDate' property with a DateTime object or null.
